name: Ariokan™ - create your cards, break the Meta
description:
About This Game

  • Create new official cards to improve your deck, and show you're the smartest Creandor in the world!

  • 10.400+ existing cards made so far by fellow Creandors, that you can use to build your deck.

  • 54+ BILLIONS of yet-to-be-created cards: the best ones haven't been imagined yet. Will you do it?

  • Additional Roguelite mode for when you want a different kind of challenge

  • Unlock a card once, use it everywhere: no need to unlock multiple copies.

  • Offline mode: so you can always play, even if one day the servers are shutdown.

  • Modding and custom game modes: Infinite replayability, your imagination is the only limit.

  • Exploit the sinergies of your God's Faction, and deal the fatal blow!

  • Bring your opponent's life points to 0, or make them run out of cards.

  • Manage your Mana, Minions and Spells, and complete mini-quests to summon powerful Legends that can turn the tides of the match.

  • Try cards you don't own against the bots before committing to them

  • Competitive scene with monthly tournaments and money prizes

Create your cards. Invent combos. Break the Meta

Forget about facing the same decks over and over: in Ariokan™, you have the power to create YOUR cards from scratch, give life to your original characters, and break the Meta.

And if you prefer to explore existing strategies, there are thousands of existing cards waiting for you.

Unleash your creativity

With the in-game Cards Editor, you can combine the effects and keywords of 8 different Factions to create balanced cards that make your deck, and strategy, truly unique.

With more than 27 billions combinations at your disposal, you'll never run out of options!

Explore 60+ playstyles with Gods and Legends

The God is the "leader” of the deck, and provides passive bonuses to all cards of its Faction. Legends are powerful units that you can summon by completing some "mini-quests" during the match, and they can suddenly turn the tides of the battle with their extreme effects. You can build your decks around them based on your favourite playstyle!

No floodgates, no 10-minutes solitaire turns

Cards are auto-balanced (i.e. no "I win" card), and immediately available worldwide to all players that want to unlock them.

Also every turn is interactive, and you can play cards as a response to each of your opponent's actions

Play with your fantasies

With every card you make, you shape Ariokan™ and its universe:

You can add artworks and lore so each card tells your story, adding a personal touch to your deck.

You're more than a player: you're part of the game!

And with every new card, new strategies arise, making Ariokan™ a game with fresh, new content every day.

Modding: make your own game modes

You can tweak the game rules when you play with your friends, and discover new ways to have fun.

Invent game modes, share them with other players, and play together: the only limit is your creativity.

Will you become the God of games?

It doesn't matter if you are a seasoned card game player or if Ariokan™ will be your first, you're welcome.

Here's what awaits you:

  • 27+ BILLION combinations: infinite replayability, your imagination is the only limit.

  • A way bring your characters into a videogame. Everything is canon!

  • No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns: you get to play and have fun

  • No "pay to win"

  • A vibrant community with monthly tournaments and competitive seasons

  • Unlock a card once, use it everywhere: no need to unlock multiple copies

  • Hundreds of hours of gameplay in PvP, PvE and sandbox modes

short_desc: Ariokan™ is a highly interactive, strategically-deep competitive card game with a twist: you can create new cards, and use them to build crazy combos around Gods and Legends to break the Meta. No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win. You can unlock cards created by other players too!
